D/ CONSTAN TINVS AVG ; R/ CONSTANTINI MAX AVG

Copper alloy coin. Silver-washed nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Arles mint Vota issue of 321, RIC vol. 7 page 260 no. 239, Reece period 16, in very fine condition. Obverse description: bull-necked bust laureate right, bare-shouldered, seen from behind. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINVS AVG. Reverse description: Vow in wreath: VOT/./XX. Reverse inscription: CONSTANTINI MAX AVG. In exergue: P [star over crescent] R. Diameter: 19.9mm, Weight: 2.38gms, die axis: 12
